description: Yixiao Ma and Mohsen Sharifi at VITO publish the MODERATE building_stock notebook collection, freely archived on Zenodo in May 2026 under CC BY 4.0. The deposit describes EU27 stock coverage and exploration, while the matching GitHub repository README documents EnergyPlus time-series generation, parametric runs and demand-disaggregation notebooks. It identifies single-family dwelling IDFs with heat pumps, with or without photovoltaics, and example EPW weather files including Brussels. These tools can generate synthetic operational inputs and compare building assumptions in energy simulations. Local EnergyPlus paths need configuration. The source stock data are separately covered by the first-review draft data-building-stock-analysis; this notebook implementation is a different repository. Related catalogue record model-energyplus is its simulation dependency. The difference between summary descriptions, exact archive contents, supported software versions and numerical uncertainty remain unverified. No notebooks or simulations were executed.
